name: 蒲甘阿难陀寺
subject: 完整寺身、中央塔冠及突出入口
author: Jakub Hałun

references.author: Vyacheslav Argenberg
references.description: It is a highly revered temple of Bagan. The Ananda Temple is a Buddhist temple built in 1105 AD during the reign of King Kyanzittha of the Pagan Dynasty. On the 900th anniversary of its construction the temple spires were gilded. Bagan, Pagan, Myanmar. A UNESCO World Heritage Site.

sources.author: Vyacheslav Argenberg

structure_checkpoints: Landscape 1536x1024. Draw the complete central Ananda Temple at Bagan in Image 2: broad square temple block, repeated terraces receding above, tall CENTRAL gilded shikhara with finial, visible smaller rooftop corner spires, and the complete protruding entrance wing at LEFT extending to its rounded gable. The low separate gateway at far RIGHT is enclosure infrastructure and must be omitted; keep the central temple body and its entrance wing to their ground line. Use this whole-view photo as main geometry; Image 3 gives detail/materials without allowing its crop to truncate the temple. Remove scaffolding from the 2016 conservation photo and show the uncluttered underlying central tower contours corroborated by Image 3. Remove tree, people, puddles, pole, outer fence/gateway. Preserve distinctly Burmese shrine/gable forms, not Thai or Chinese pagoda roofs.
material_observations: 浅象牙白与灰米色灰泥寺身，中央塔冠金色，小塔上部有金饰和局部暗红底座；后世修缮外观。
source_note: 依据所列实拍进行艺术简化；范围为完整寺身、中央塔冠及突出入口。原型待用户人眼验收，不作实测或文保复原声明。
